dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: I'm very sorry, but Muning's glaring at me again. I don't think I'll be able to chat long. There's still a lot of odd errands to do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you. Good luck out there.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: See you! *sigh* Ah, this stuff is becoming quite the headache...

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: She's not a bad person, but she's far too obstinate. I don't know why she's in such a hurry, too. If it were me, I would be ducking for cover at the first sign of danger.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: *sigh* Never mind. I just pray for her safety.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Thanks for saving me! I was beginning to think that I might become dog food at this rate...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Hey now, that's not a good joke.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And how did you end up in this sorry state?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Me? I was helping Erge out... But I screwed up and got chucked into this cage.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Him? He's from Mingyun Village. Used to work over there. After they ran the ore veins dry, he came to The Chasm. Did pretty well too. Made foreman, I believe.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Then... you know the story. The Chasm went "woosh," and the miners went "whoa," and the Ministry of Civil Affairs did a "Hmm? Hmm? Hmm?"

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: And the Qixing bigwigs did a "ahem-ahem!" and the Millelith came and went "hmph-hmph-hmph!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What the heck is this guy saying?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Try speaking the common tongue, please.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Well, in the end, the mine was closed and the miners went out of work. And when miners get put out of a job, what do you think they'll do they do to make ends meet, hmm?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Well, what I'm saying is Erge was an experienced miner who barely ever saw the light of day in his life, and who had just made foreman at 40... and then suddenly, it was all gone!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: So, what would he do, and where?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, join... the Treasure Hoarders?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Exactly! See, now you're thinking like a Hoarder!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: But lemme give you some sage advice: it might be best not to do anything illegal. The Treasure Hoarders aren't good people, no, not at all. And there's no going back once you've gone too far into a life of crime...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-huh, that's right... Paimon won't ever become a Treasure Hoarder...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: —Which is pretty rich, coming from you!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Hahahaha! I mean... Well, let's not joke about this anymore. In any case, what I meant to say was that people don't necessarily join the Treasure Hoarders because of some inherent evil in their hearts.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: But for Erge, the compensation from the Ministry of Civil Affairs should have been enough to let him start over in an honest profession, and yet he chose this path.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: I guess to each his own, huh? Maybe some people just can't take the pain in the short term, and choose a perilous road of bringing others pain instead. Perhaps this is what we'd call "the other side of freedom" back in Mondstadt.

choices.text: So, tell me about, well, you.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Me? Just me? I'm no one important.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: I'm from Mondstadt, and I haven't been a Hoarder long, nor have I been in Liyue long. I just came with a few senior members to get some ore.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: I was following Erge around, doing some errands, helping them sneak around a bit, contacting our comrades down in the mines... and then, you know, I got caught by you while doing those things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not correct. You were in this cage well before we caught you doing anything.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: *sigh* Well, I mucked up on one of my tasks, which caused our lads to get ambushed by someone...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Now that was us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehe...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: So that was really... I knew it was you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it was nothing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And anyway, we didn't know how you'd get involved in the whole thing, either.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Ugh... Anyway, I was sent by Erge to keep watch on our Weasel Thieves after that... And I made another mistake in allowing them to run amok. They stole all our stuff...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pfft... Hahaha!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Yes, yes, keep laughing. Just make sure your stomach stays in one piece while you're at it... Ugh, that was embarrassing.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Still after that, Erge sent me down to find some secret passage. I did find it... and then the earthquake happened! Nearly buried us all alive, too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know what? I think... that might have been us, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, that's right! That must've happened when we destroyed... uh, unsealed the Bedrock Keys. It was a pretty big earthquake, too!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: And if Erge was mad at me before, now he was absolutely hopping mad!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: "You worthless piece of trash! I'll bet the Millelith sent you here to sabotage us, didn't they?"

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: "And you did wreck us, didn't you? Let our Weasel Thieves run off, did you? Boys, put him in the Weasel Thief cage! We'll settle scores with him once we're done with this transaction!"

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: ...That's what he said.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: And then he locked me in this cage. Might have forgotten to mention that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahahahaha! Paimon almost feels bad for Erge!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Well, yes, he did get slapped around by the two of you. Twice.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Not... not that I'm feeling sorry for him, of course! I'm just glad that you came to my rescue. I'd be dead meat otherwise.

choices.text: Ah, what a shame that we don't keep dogs either.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Ah, you're here! Welcome to the Chasm Exploration Team's demolitions team base and water point!

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: We — by which I mean I, Clitopho — salute you!

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Come, come, have a drink! Consider it my treat — just a little something for all you've done for me.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Well, I'm an official member of the team now, so since they're staying, I'm staying.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Well, things would certainly be easier if Khedive and Jinwu could get me some extra help...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Though that said, I wouldn't be able to call myself the sole member *and* team leader if that were to happen.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}! It's great to see you here.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Let's have a drink to slake our thirsts. My treat!

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: No need, just tell me whenever you need some refreshment!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How have you been recently?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Oh, neither good nor bad, really. But at least I no longer have any regrets.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Back when I was studying alchemy in Mondstadt, I believed that even overly-ordinary children like myself could reach our dreams.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: But as I studied, I realized that there are some gulfs that cannot be bridged, and some people who cannot be caught up to.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: That's when I realized that alchemy is really for those who either have immense talent or resources.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: The color of my dreams... they just weren't the same as theirs.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And that's why you joined the Treasure Hoarders?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: *sigh* Well, I wasn't going to accept a lifetime of mediocrity, that's for sure. And I mean, there are those fated to do good, and those fated to do evil in this world, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you still believe that?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Heh. Alright... Stop scolding me, you're starting to sound like Jinwu. And yes, I know I was wrong...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Jinwu talked to me about this as well, and she had the right of it for sure...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: "Whether it's those who received the gods' favor, or those who are just lucky... They're like proud birds with their wings spread wide, living for themselves, looking far out into the distance."

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: "As for the places that they don't see, and the places they won't go, well, those are for people like us to build up, to watch over, to defend..."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It sure beats being a bandit and hurting others.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Yeah... Becoming a Treasure Hoarder and all that... all I did in chasing such selfish freedom was bringing misfortune on myself.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: And while the things we're doing right now are ordinary, they have impact beyond us or even people around us.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: I mean... Someone's got to do this job, and we ordinary people just happen to be here, right?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Regardless, thank you both very much for helping me understand that ordinary work is not meaningless.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Phew, alright. Let's cut the chatter about pointless stuff. What say you to a drink? I've still got loads of "Real Man's Meds" on me, you know?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on! Are you seriously still trying to sell us fake medicine?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: I was sent up here by Jinwu. The Millelith might be sending a batch of blasting equipment over here soon, but she's busy at the campsite and can't leave at the moment.
